target.title: fix(agents): align mid-turn tool-result precheck estimates
target.body:
Closes #101929

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where embedded agent runs with mid-turn context precheck enabled could hit false context-overflow recovery after several large tool results, even though the provider-boundary prompt would fit once OpenClaw applied its normal live tool-result projection.

## Why This Change Was Made

The mid-turn precheck now estimates the same post-truncation tool-result view that the next provider prompt path sends, and plain text tool results use the normal text token-density estimate instead of an extra 2 chars/token penalty. The projection uses the model context window for tool-result caps and keeps reserve-token pressure in the precheck decision, so lower prompt budgets still route to compaction when the provider-boundary view is too large. Risk note: this touches session-state context routing, so the tests cover both false-positive suppression and the lower-budget overflow case where a structured mid-turn signal must still fire.

## User Impact

Users running tool-heavy agent sessions should see fewer unnecessary mid-turn context-overflow aborts or compaction retries when tool results have already been bounded for the next model call. Runs that are genuinely over the effective prompt budget still raise the structured mid-turn precheck path.

## Evidence

Source/dependency checks:
- Current OpenClaw source check: the pre-prompt/provider prompt path already calls `truncateOversizedToolResultsInMessages` before model submission, while the mid-turn precheck previously estimated the raw post-tool transcript.
- OpenAI Codex dependency source checked locally: `codex-rs/codex-api/src/common.rs:200`, `codex-rs/codex-api/src/endpoint/responses_websocket.rs:760`, and `codex-rs/core/src/client.rs:540`, `codex-rs/core/src/client.rs:860`, `codex-rs/core/src/client.rs:1180`, `codex-rs/core/src/client.rs:1568`. The request builders serialize the supplied input/messages and preserve websocket request fields; there is no hidden expansion that would justify estimating already-projected tool-result text at a separate 2 chars/token ratio.

Focused validation:
```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/preemptive-compaction.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/tool-result-context-guard.test.ts
Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests  69 passed (69)
```

```text
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo
# passed
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.test.src.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/test-src.tsbuildinfo
# passed
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/preemptive-compaction.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/preemptive-compaction.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/tool-result-context-guard.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/tool-result-context-guard.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.
git diff --check
# passed
pnpm build
# passed
```

Live behavior proof with isolated local OpenClaw state and `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`:
- Configured an effective `contextTokens: 160000`, `reserveTokens: 50000`, `toolResultMaxChars: 16000`, and `midTurnPrecheck.enabled: true`.
- Ran `pnpm openclaw agent --local --json --agent main --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro --thinking off` with a prompt that required five shell tool calls, each producing a 50,000-character marker payload.
- Observed five `SEGMENT_1` through `SEGMENT_5` markers and final `PROOF_DONE midturn-precheck large tool results completed`.
- Observed six successful `https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions` responses with status 200.
- Observed no `context-overflow-midturn-precheck`, `preemptive`, or `Context overflow` markers in stderr for the passing run.

Review:
```text

autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported

```
